e.summary: 开源 XoL/停止损失再保分层定价引擎（Python）：频率-强度蒙特卡洛 → 分出损失分布 → 技术保费
e.summary_en: Open-source XoL / stop-loss reinsurance layer pricing engine (Python): frequency-severity Monte Carlo to ceded loss distributions and technical premiums
e.summary_hk: 開源 XoL/停止損失再保分層定價引擎（Python）：頻率-強度蒙特卡洛 → 分出損失分布 → 技術保費
e.body: Reinsurance Layer Pricing Engine（`RS-ins/Reinsurance-Layer-Pricing-Engine`，Python 3.10+，2026-04-28 建仓 / 2026-05-10 更新）是**开源的再保分层定价引擎**：用频率-强度蒙特卡洛模拟构造**年度总损失分布**，套上再保合约结构，推导**分出损失分布、风险度量与技术保费**（含资本成本加载）。支持的合约要素覆盖实操中最关键的那几项：**Excess-of-Loss（XL）与 Stop-Loss** 两大类、**年度累计限额（Aggregate Annual Limit）**、**年度累计免赔（Annual Aggregate Deductible）**与**恢复保费（reinstatement premiums）**；分布参数可手工指定，也可用最大似然从历史损失数据自动拟合。项目另提供一个**在线交互仪表盘**（11,250+ 预计算情景，可拖动滑杆看合约结构、频率分布、严重性尾部、资本成本如何影响技术保费，每张指标卡附白话解释）。对 RIAA：**分层定价与分出结构**是再保定价的核心技能，而开源侧长期缺少完整实现——池内再保族此前偏「合约数据/合约文本/保费计算」（[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]、[[reinsurer]]、[[reinspy]]、[[rippy]]、[[reins]]）或商业/经纪侧工具（[[layerloss-locktonre]]），本引擎补的是**「分层结构 → 分出损失分布 → 技术保费」这条完整链路**；与 [[monte-carlo]]、[[aggregate-python]]（聚合损失分布）、[[retention]]（自留额）配套，巨灾场景可接 [[catmodeling]] 与 [[oasislmf]]；适合作再保定价、分出结构与资本成本方向。注意：仓库星标 4（新项目），许可证以仓库 README 标注的 Apache 2.0 为准（GitHub API 未识别到 SPDX 标识）。
e.body_en: The Reinsurance Layer Pricing Engine (`RS-ins/Reinsurance-Layer-Pricing-Engine`, Python 3.10+, created 2026-04-28 / updated 2026-05-10) is an **open-source reinsurance layer pricing engine**: it uses frequency-severity Monte Carlo simulation to build an **aggregate annual loss distribution**, applies reinsurance treaty structures, and derives **ceded loss distributions, risk measures and capital-loaded technical premiums**. The treaty features it supports are the practically critical ones: **Excess-of-Loss (XL) and Stop-Loss** treaty types, **Aggregate Annual Limits**, **Annual Aggregate Deductibles** and **reinstatement premiums**; distribution parameters can be set manually or fitted automatically from historical loss data by maximum likelihood. The project also ships an **interactive online dashboard** (11,250+ pre-computed scenarios) where sliders show how treaty structure, frequency distribution, severity tail and cost of capital move the technical premium, with plain-English explanations on each metric card. For RIAA: **layer pricing and cession structure** are core reinsurance pricing skills, and the open-source side has long lacked a complete implementation — this corpus’s reinsurance family previously leaned toward contract data, contract text or premium calculators ([[reinsurance-contracts-repository]], [[reinsurer]], [[reinspy]], [[rippy]], [[reins]]) or commercial/broker tools ([[layerloss-locktonre]]); this engine fills in the **full chain "layer structure → ceded loss distribution → technical premium"**; it pairs with [[monte-carlo]] and [[aggregate-python]] (aggregate loss distributions) and [[retention]] (retentions), and catastrophe scenarios can connect to [[catmodeling]] and [[oasislmf]]; suits reinsurance pricing, cession structuring and cost-of-capital work. Note: 4 stars (new project); licence per the Apache 2.0 badge in the repository README (GitHub’s API did not detect an SPDX identifier).
e.body_hk: Reinsurance Layer Pricing Engine（`RS-ins/Reinsurance-Layer-Pricing-Engine`，Python 3.10+，2026-04-28 建倉 / 2026-05-10 更新）是**開源的再保分層定價引擎**：用頻率-強度蒙特卡洛模擬構造**年度總損失分布**，套上再保合約結構，推導**分出損失分布、風險度量與技術保費**（含資本成本加載）。支持的合約要素覆蓋實操中最關鍵的幾項：**Excess-of-Loss（XL）與 Stop-Loss** 兩大類、**年度累計限額**、**年度累計免賠**與**恢復保費（reinstatement premiums）**；分布參數可手工指定，也可用最大似然從歷史損失數據自動擬合。項目另提供**在線交互儀表盤**（11,250+ 預計算情景）。對 RIAA：**分層定價與分出結構**是再保定價的核心技能，而開源側長期缺少完整實現——池內再保族此前偏「合約數據/合約文本/保費計算」（[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]、[[reinsurer]]、[[reinspy]]、[[rippy]]、[[reins]]）或商業/經紀側工具（[[layerloss-locktonre]]），本引擎補的是**「分層結構 → 分出損失分布 → 技術保費」這條完整鏈路**；與 [[monte-carlo]]、[[aggregate-python]]、[[retention]] 配套，巨災場景可接 [[catmodeling]] 與 [[oasislmf]]；適合作再保定價、分出結構與資本成本方向。注意：倉庫星標 4（新項目），許可證以 README 標註的 Apache 2.0 為準。
e.verified_note: GitHub 仓库 + README 核实（Python 3.10+、XoL/Stop-Loss、年度累计限额/免赔、恢复保费、MLE 参数拟合、11,250+ 情景在线仪表盘；README 标注 Apache 2.0），未安装实测
